content:
Realization: It's not reasonable to interpret everything outside of instant success as failure.
I know this seems like a really obvious thing to say, but I think somewhere along the way, I genuinely, unconsciously started believing that any unforeseen delays in progress, mistakes, negative reactions from others, etc. = failure. Even mild successes, if they were behind schedule or weren't big enough, became re-interpreted in my brain as basically being small failures. So over time, I started thinking that I was doomed to fail at everything.

I'm still working on changing my mindset around this, but it's just a huge relief to be able to at least label that as an unreasonable thought. Tonight when I was journaling after watching some of Dr. K's videos, I feel like it finally started to actually sink in a little for the first time.

We might not be instant successes, but we're also not failures :-)
